card.name: Linking words before hidden causes
card.fires_on: Small linking words (were, is, a, of, be) and adjectives like unrecognized or underlying that come right before a hidden, underlying or possible cause or condition. Typical settings are presence of illness, ideas of reference, or disagreement.

modes.label: Words before an underlying illness
modes.description: Short linking word or adjective just before an underlying or unrecognized condition.
modes.example: may be the result of an<< unrecognized>> underlying psychiatric or medical disorder and can emerge

modes.label: Words before a doubted claim
modes.description: Linking verb after a subject in skeptical or disputed accounts, before a claimed explanation.
modes.example: The witnesses<< were>> just “seeing things.” REFERENCES AND FOOT

modes.label: Of after presence or ideas
modes.description: The word of in phrases like presence of or ideas of before a condition or delusion term.
modes.example: One healthy male volunteer developed ideas<< of>> reference, paranoid delusions, and auditory
